articles.title: White House fires back after Noah Kahan says he’d ‘never approve’ Trump administration using his music - Entertainment Weekly
articles.description: Noah Kahan is the latest musician to speak out about the Trump administration using his music without permission. Kahan’s song ‘American Cars’ was used to promote Trump’s recent visit to a GM facility.
articles.content:
Noah Kahan is joining the growing list of musicians who dont want to be associated with the Trump administration.
